mechanics.body_shape: install an exception frame, alias the receiver into EDI, read the array's begin, end and mode byte and form receiver+0x18, run one cdecl ordered search for the key word, narrow the result to an exact match, then either assign into the matched element's record or build a seed entry in the frame, assign into it, hand it plus an out record to a find-or-insert, and conditionally report; increment the receiver's word at +0x34 exactly once on every path and unwind the frame

frame_resolution.method: one linear walk of ESP through all 65 instructions, using each callee's own RET immediate to settle the stack after every call. Entry ESP is 0 in the walk; the walk ends at +12, which is entry+4 (return address) +8 (the two argument words), so the frame balances exactly.
frame_resolution.corroboration: two independent agreements. (1) 0x006a2ed4 reads [ESP+0x2c] with ESP = entry-56, i.e. entry-12, which is precisely where 0x006a2e2d's PUSH EAX put the old FS:[0]; the epilogue therefore restores the exception head the prologue installed, and after the three POPs ADD ESP,0x2c lands back on entry ESP. (2) 0x006a2ec8 forms ECX with LEA ECX,[ESP+0x1c] at ESP = entry-60, i.e. entry-32, and 0x0093db80's own first instruction is TEST BYTE PTR [ESI+0x10],0x4 -- entry-32+0x10 is entry-16, which is the exact word 0x006a2eb7 tested at [ESP+0x28] with ESP = entry-56. The two agree only under this frame.

slots.entry-32: the seed entry's embedded 0x14-byte record: the destination of the 0x006a2e99 call and the receiver of the 0x006a2ecc call
slots.entry-16: that record's word at +16, zeroed at 0x006a2e8f and tested at 0x006a2eb7

mechanics.control_flow: five conditional branches, all with absolute targets inside the recovered body span 0x006a2e20..0x006a2ee5: JZ 0x006a2e6d (0x006a2e60), JB 0x006a2e6d (0x006a2e64, printed by Ghidra as JC, the carry-set synonym of the 0x72 opcode the bytes are), JNZ 0x006a2e6f (0x006a2e6b), JZ 0x006a2e83 (0x006a2e77) and JZ 0x006a2ed1 (0x006a2ec4); plus one unconditional JMP 0x006a2ed1 at 0x006a2e81, which is intra-procedural control flow and lands back inside the body. The branch at 0x006a2e6b is the one-past-the-end probe the search leaves behind (LEA ECX,[EAX+0x18]; CMP EAX,ECX -- never equal) and makes no decision; it is reproduced as an annotation and carries no branch in the model.
mechanics.arm_decision: the candidate is normalised to the array end when the search returned the end (0x006a2e60) OR when the key is below the candidate's leading dword as an UNSIGNED compare (0x006a2e64). The arm is then chosen by 0x006a2e74: equal to the end means insert, anything else means assign into candidate+0x04.
mechanics.exact_find_not_lower_bound: the CMP/JB pair converts the search's lower_bound into an exact-match test. A lower_bound alone would return the first element >= key; 0x006a2e64 discards that element when it is strictly greater, so the surviving candidate has field_00 == key or the body takes the insert arm.
mechanics.not_modelled: the SEH install and unwind, the 0x006a2e66/0x006a2e69/0x006a2e6b no-op probe, and the writes of the try-level word as a machine stack slot (the model keeps the word in a file-scope variable so the test can assert the ORDER of the two stores around 0x006a2c50; that is instrumentation and is declared as such in the header).
mechanics.globals: none: the complete 65-instruction listing names no data-segment address. The one absolute operand outside the body is the immediate 0x0120d6b8 pushed at 0x006a2e28, which is a code address (an exception handler), not data.

mechanics.return_semantics_machine: void, per both records (abi.return_type 'void', ghidra_function.return_type 'void'). The machine agrees: the receiver is copied into EDI at 0x006a2e3b and never moved into EAX on any path, and the epilogue writes no return value. EAX is dead at 0x006a2ee5 and in fact holds three different dead values depending on the path -- the surviving search candidate (or the array end from 0x006a2e6d) on the found arm, 0x006a2c50's own return word on the insert arm when the bit test is clear, and 0x0093db80's return word when it runs. Nothing is modelled for EAX and the model test asserts nothing about it.

return_semantics.ownership: The body performs no reference acquisition or release of its own. It reads a pointer to the array and hands addresses to three callees; whether the array is owned, borrowed or a smart handle is not established by any record for this target and is not claimed.
return_semantics.lifetime: The seed entry and the out record are frame objects that die with the call. The seed entry is handed to 0x006a2c50, which is the one that stores it into the array (through 0x006a2940 or 0x006a22a0), so its lifetime is correctly bounded by this call.

unresolved_questions: This VA now has TWO metadata sidecars and TWO staging packages: this one and reconstruction/metadata/pkg-proplist-setprop-w15/006a2e20.json. reconstruction_knowledge.extract_metadata merges source_files per VA and sorted_unique()s them, and validate._source() returns the first existing staging path, so `pkg-dfw-006a2e20` sorts before `pkg-proplist-setprop-w15` and the validator now resolves THIS package's source for 0x006a2e20. The prior package's own recorded validation results therefore no longer describe what the validator reports for this VA. That is a property of the index, not an edit to either package, and it is the integrator's call which one to keep.

The frame disagrees with the one the prior session recorded. That session's validation.md places the 0x006a2c50 arguments at entry-0x30 and entry-0x24, the 4-byte state word at entry-0x2c, and 0x0093db80's receiver at entry-0x2c, and calls the state word a mirror 'two frames away' from the try level. The byte walk in this package puts the seed ENTRY at entry-36 and the OUT RECORD at entry-44 (the opposite assignment to the prior session's), the state word at entry-4 itself (the try level's own slot, which is what the MSVC trylevel encoding is), and 0x0093db80's receiver at entry-32. The two independent corroborations in mechanics.frame_resolution both only hold under this walk. I could not re-run the prior session's arithmetic and it is not my file, so this is reported as a disagreement rather than a correction.

What is the 4-byte word at entry-4? It is the slot `PUSH -0x1` fills and the body's only two writes to it (0 at 0x006a2eaa, 0xffffffff at 0x006a2ebc) bracket the 0x006a2c50 call, which is the standard MSVC try-level encoding for entering and leaving a __try scope. Nothing in this body reads it, and neither the handler at 0x0120d6b8 nor the cleanup body that must exist for the counter increment to be exception-safe has been identified.

What selects a different comparator is not established. The byte at the receiver's +0x2c is passed to 0x00612db0 as its fourth word and 0x006a2c50 reads the same byte as its object's +0x14, but the recovered 0x00612db0 never reads its fourth slot. Either the word is for a different overload of that address or the comparator selection happens somewhere this body does not show.

Why does 0x0093db80 get a receiver that this body has just tested and found flagged, and then get argument 0? With argument 0 the callee's clearing half does not run, so the call is a report whose result this body ignores. Whether the report is load-bearing (an out-of-line handler) or vestigial is not established here.

Is the search at 0x00612db0 always a lower_bound on the leading dword? Its body computes the count as (last-first)/0x18 and compares the leading dword unsigned, which is a lower_bound. Whether 0x006a2c50's copy of that call can dispatch to a different overload with a different comparator is not established by any record in this repository.
